note: Parser limitation: DBLK_A_MAIN10_VIXS_4 is a valid JCT-VC HEVC v1 conformance vector (Main10 profile, 176x144, 10-bit 4:2:0) but our short_term_rps walker returns ReservedValue for delta_idx_minus1 on the 9th RPS entry. This is a known parser bug (cursor misalignment in the inter-predicted RPS walk); tracked as a follow-up plan. The true expected fields are: width=176, height=144, bit_depth_luma=10, bit_depth_chroma=10, chroma_format=Yuv420, general_profile_idc=2, general_level_idc=120.
